as_told.title: UAP drawn to nuclear and WMD facilities

plain: The claim is that UFOs show up again and again around nuclear weapons sites and nuclear plants all over the world. If true, it would mean whatever is behind them takes a special interest in humanity's most dangerous weapons. A former intelligence official named Eric Haseltine treats the idea carefully. He says the honest answer is "maybe yes, maybe no," and points out that there are simply far more sensors around nuclear plants, so more sightings would be logged there anyway. Michels, in another episode, states it more plainly as a known pattern, saying UFOs "show up around nuclear sites all over the world," without that caveat. A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown goes furthest. He says it is "established beyond a reasonable doubt" and that the attraction covers not only nuclear sites but weapons of mass destruction in general. Brown credits a former Air Force officer named Robert Salas and a work called UFOs and Nukes for this, so his telling leans on others' research while Haseltine and Michels speak in their own voices.
